cohort.source_memory: independent cold source actor per family and role, carry own selected public consequence experience across 3 original dev seed episodes; never share source actions or memory across controls

mechanism.name: Mission-conditioned coarse public-context transfer of own selected task-consequence eligibility credits
mechanism.source: Unchanged original MG52 selected goal-signal detector and MG47 original default selection; new behavior is pooled action-value across public contexts, not a hand-scripted world route or known hidden destination.
mechanism.context: Goal literal + publicly visible front object type; when front is a door also public door state2 vs1 vs0; additionally public exact target visible anywhere boolean. Exclude heading, color and exact 7x7 public image; far fewer public contexts than MG52, explicitly an engineered similarity assumption not proven state equivalence.
mechanism.trace: Every own source-selected public context and action, last 8 selected actions within same episode; at source-observed target first visibility credit2, real public locked-door opening credit3, genuine selected mission-target pickup effect credit6, original positive terminal reward credit10. Geometric backward eligibility 1/2 per step; also credit newest own action. No hidden world state or privilege.
mechanism.update: For each (pooled context,selected original action0-6) record source-selected count and cumulative credit only, bounded 2048 keys per family. Record real source effect event count; never use terminal feedback before original step executes. Reset recent queue at each new original source episode.
mechanism.action: Call unchanged MG47 source selected choose first. While phase seek, if original chooses action0 left/1 right/2 forward and no mission target in source public front, with at least one earlier authentic source goal-relevance event, compare credit/(count+2) for safe actions0,1,2. A candidate requires >=2 own selected samples in pooled context; if action has higher value than parent's original selected action by >=0.125, choose highest (ties original then lowest action). Do not select forward with public wall/door/portable object in front. Never override source-selected action3 pickup,4 drop,5 door toggle or MG44 release/retry FSM.
mechanism.same_model_ablation: Same exact public pooled state aggregation, own selected source memory, credit update, checkpoint and original MG47 parent policy but intervention disabled. Its action path should equal unchanged MG47 on same original source seed.
mechanism.limits: Learned values are correlations under chosen actions. Reduced public-context state detail introduces possible aliasing, hidden physical locality is unknown; task improvement, if any, must be real authentic goals.

outcomes.primary: Authentic original terminal goal-positive episodes in new KeyCorridor (both) and ObstructedMaze original Farama pinned DEV cohorts, exact public target sightings and own selected target pickup effects.
outcomes.secondary: Actual source-selected steering overrides, count of genuine goal-relevant event steps, retained credit, episode action/resource accounting, exact source and cold-checkpoint reproductions.
comparators: same-model pooled credit with intervention disabled
unchanged original MG52 goal eligibility ON/OFF
unchanged original MG47 door memory ON
unchanged conventional MG34 graph lookahead, MG33 frontier and exact corrected MG33C UCB/RR
outcomes.resources: Original source-selected action counts, auxiliary host wall and Python/child CPU, not equal native RSS/energy parity

requirements: at least one authentic original first exact public mission target sighting in a larger KeyCorridor
at least one authentic original positive terminal goal episode in larger KeyCorridor
at least one authentic original positive terminal goal in ObstructedMaze
strictly more genuine total goal episodes than each listed comparator including identical pooled learning with intervention disabled
at least one genuine own selected prior-credit-supported action override
two original full source processes exact canonical equality and cross-OS frozen preflight before any new world actions
